name: Welcome series
triggerText: Status becomes New – Bot chat (any source except ads, which get D2).
stopsWhenText: Replies, books a call or demo, or status changes.
goal: Turn a silent enquiry into a conversation.
afterwardsText: No reply by day 10 → Nurture – Later.

steps.notes: Only if no reply.

name: Ad lead nurture
triggerText: New lead with Source = FB ad or IG ad (lead form or click-to-WhatsApp).
goal: Ad leads cool fastest — catch them in the first hour and answer the fear the ad stirred up.
afterwardsText: Day 9 exit message decides: Nurture – Later, Counselled, or Lost.

steps.notes: Lead form ads only.

steps.text: counsellor call task — ad leads are called within 30 minutes in office hours.

name: No-answer chase
triggerText: Status becomes Contacted – No answer.
stopsWhenText: Picks up, replies, or status changes.
goal: Most missed calls are bad timing, not lack of interest. Let them choose the time — or use WhatsApp instead.
afterwardsText: Day 7 with no response → Lost – Not reachable (they come back to New if they ever message).

steps.text: 2nd and 3rd call attempts — evenings 4–6 pm get the most pick-ups.
steps.notes: 2nd attempt ~4 hours later, 3rd the next evening (4–6 pm best); 240 used.

name: Call-back promise
triggerText: Status becomes Contacted – Call back (with a time).
goal: Keep the promise. A missed call-back loses trust instantly.
afterwardsText: Counsellor sets the next status after the call.

steps.text: reminder to the counsellor; alert the team lead if the call isn't logged 30 minutes after the time.
steps.notes: Relative to the promised call-back time ({{callback_time}}), not the drip start.

name: After counselling
triggerText: Status becomes Counselled.
stopsWhenText: Moves to Hot, Demo booked, Fee pending, or any objection status.
goal: Put the call in writing so the student (and family) can re-read it.

name: Interested follow-up (Warm)
triggerText: Status becomes Interested – Warm.
stopsWhenText: Hot, Demo booked, Fee pending, Converted, or Not interested.
goal: Keep the course top of mind with proof and a reason to act now.

name: Family approval
triggerText: Status becomes Interested – Family approval (or Objection tag = Family).
goal: Help the student win the family conversation and bring parents to the centre.

name: Price concern
triggerText: Status becomes Interested – Price concern (or Objection tag = Price).
stopsWhenText: Fee plan agreed (Fee pending), Converted, or Nurture.
goal: Turn a big number into a manageable plan without discounting the value.
afterwardsText: Day 7 → counsellor call with a custom plan, then Warm.

steps.text: counsellor call to build a plan (track, EMI, online, package).
steps.notes: No send time given in the PDF.

name: Demo booked
triggerText: Status becomes Demo – Booked.
goal: Show-up rate is everything — remind, reassure, make it easy to find.
afterwardsText: 3 hours after demo time with no mark → task to counsellor.

steps.notes: Relative to the demo date (evening before the demo), not the drip start.
Relative to the demo time ({{demo_time}}), not the drip start.

name: Demo no-show
triggerText: Status becomes Demo – No-show.
goal: No guilt — just a new time.

name: After the demo
triggerText: Status becomes Demo – Attended (not enrolled).
goal: The demo built desire — answer the last questions and give a reason to start this batch.

name: Fee pending
triggerText: Status becomes Admission – Fee pending.
goal: Remove friction from paying.

steps.text: move to Hot and alert the manager.
steps.notes: No send time given in the PDF.

name: Onboarding (enrolled)
triggerText: Status becomes Converted – Enrolled.
goal: A great first month means fewer drop-outs, better reviews and more referrals.

steps.notes: Relative to the first class / batch start date, not enrolment.
Sent after the first class (batch start date); relative to class 1, not enrolment.
No send time given in the PDF.
No send time given in the PDF.

steps.when: Any time: missed 2 classes in a row
steps.text: counsellor calls the student the same day — early drop-out signal.
steps.notes: Event-triggered (2 consecutive absences), not time-based.

name: Completion, internship and placement
triggerText: Status becomes Converted – Completed.
goal: Celebrate, guide the next step, and collect proof (reviews, videos) that sells the next batch.
afterwardsText: Hands over to Refer & earn and Anniversary.

steps.notes: No send time given in the PDF.
No send time given in the PDF.
No send time given in the PDF.

name: Refer & earn
triggerText: Converted – Enrolled for 30+ days, or Converted – Completed.
goal: Happy students bring friends who already trust you — the cheapest, best-converting leads.
afterwardsText: Repeats every 60 days, max 4 times a year.

steps.notes: Event-triggered: a referred friend enrols.

name: Long-term nurture
triggerText: Status becomes Nurture – Later.
stopsWhenText: Replies (→ Hot), Converted, or Opted out.
goal: Stay useful for months so they come back when the timing is right.

steps.notes: "Month 1" approximated as day 30; no send time given.
"Month 2" approximated as day 60; no send time given.
"Month 3" approximated as day 90; no send time given.
"Month 4" approximated as day 120; no send time given.
"Month 6" approximated as day 180; no send time given.

name: Joined elsewhere
triggerText: Status becomes Lost – Joined elsewhere.
goal: Stay friendly — many want practice, an internship or an advanced course later.

steps.notes: No send time given in the PDF.
No send time given in the PDF.

name: Birthday offer
triggerText: Birthday date (leads not yet converted, and students).
goal: A warm, personal touch — and a time-bound reason to join.

steps.notes: On the birthday; for leads (not yet converted).
On the birthday; for students.

name: Anniversary wish
triggerText: Joining date anniversary (students and alumni).
goal: Reconnect alumni: celebrate progress, ask for referrals, offer the next course.

steps.notes: On the joining-date anniversary.

name: Fee & EMI instalment reminders
triggerText: Instalment due date (fee plan field) for Converted – Enrolled students.
goal: Collect on time without awkward calls; every payment gets an instant receipt.
afterwardsText: Day +5 overdue → accounts/counsellor task; day +10 → manager.

steps.notes: Relative to the instalment due date.
On the instalment due date.
1 day after the instalment due date.
Event-triggered: payment recorded.

steps.text: accounts task to agree a new date; record it in the fee plan so reminders follow the new date.
steps.notes: Event-triggered: student taps "Need more time".

name: Attendance & absence
triggerText: Attendance marked absent (classroom) or not joined (online).
goal: Catch drop-outs in week one, not month three.
afterwardsText: 2 absences in a row → counsellor call; parent message if the student is under 18 or parent number saved.

steps.notes: Same day the absence is marked.
Event-triggered: second consecutive absence.
Recurring: 1st of every month.

name: Class updates & online links
triggerText: Class schedule (per batch) and admin announcements.
goal: No student ever misses a class because of a missing link or a schedule change.

steps.notes: Recurring, relative to each online class start time.
Recurring: after each online class.
Event-triggered: schedule change.
Before the holiday date; exact lead time not given (-1 day assumed).

name: Assignments & assessments
triggerText: Assignment due dates and assessment dates per batch.
goal: Keep practice on track — practice is what builds the portfolio.

steps.notes: Relative to the assignment due date.
Relative to the assessment date.
Event-triggered: assessment result shared.

name: Monthly progress & feedback (NPS)
triggerText: Every 30 days for Converted – Enrolled.
goal: Show progress to students and parents, and catch unhappy students before they post a bad review.
afterwardsText: Score 0–6 → manager call within 24 h. Score 9–10 → Google review request.

steps.notes: Recurring every 30 days (day 30, 60, 90…).
Day after the previous step/event.

name: Admission documents pending
triggerText: Enrolled with documents field incomplete.
goal: Complete files without chasing in class.

steps.notes: No send time given in the PDF.

name: Certificate & college documents
triggerText: Certificate or training letter marked ready.
goal: Instant good news — a natural moment to ask for a review.

steps.notes: Event-triggered: certificate/letter marked ready.

name: Placement & job alerts
triggerText: New job opening matching the student's course tag (Completed students, and Enrolled in the last month).
stopsWhenText: Student tagged Placed, or opts out of job alerts.
goal: Visible placement assistance — and proof stories for the next batch.
afterwardsText: On "Got a job" → tag Placed, ask for a testimonial.

steps.notes: Event-triggered: new matching job opening.
Relative to the interview date.
Relative to the interview date.

name: Workshops & webinars
triggerText: Registered for a free workshop or webinar.
goal: Free events turn cold leads warm; the follow-up converts them.
afterwardsText: Attended → Interested – Warm with the workshop's course tag.

steps.notes: Relative to the event start time.
Day after the previous step/event.
